recentItems.title: Ella Beatty reacts to her mom, Annette Bening, as she shares some of her earliest memories
recentItems.description: Ella Beatty reacts to her mom, Annette Bening, as she shares some of her earliest memories from her last time on the TODAY show. Beatty stars as Lizzie Borden in Netflix’s “Monster: The Lizzie Borden Story,” premiering Sept. 17.

recentItems.title: Chelsea Frei on ‘The Paper’ S2, Breaking Character, NBC Internship
recentItems.description:
Star of “The Paper” Chelsea Frei stops by TODAY to talk about Season 2 of the hit spinoff of “The Office." She shares how she gets to weigh-in on her character’s arc, and how she always breaks on set. “I had to tell our cameraman crew, Phil, ‘do not cut to me with the camera because I’m just going to keep ruining this take,’” she joked. She also talks about interning at NBC and 'SNL' alum Fred Armisen crashing her interview.

recentItems.title: Oasis Reunites Once Again for 2027 Tour in UK, Europe, US
recentItems.description:
Liam and Noel Gallagher are getting the band back together once more. Oasis is officially returning to the road in 2027 for another run of shows across the UK, Europe and the United States. It will kick off in May in Glasgow and head stateside to Boston’s Gillette Stadium in August.

recentItems.title: Celebs Share Favorite Movies of All Time in '50 Movie Nights' Book
recentItems.description:
Author and journalist Dave Karger joins TODAY to talk about his new book “50 Movie Nights” which asks some of Hollywood’s biggest stars about the films that inspired their careers. He interviewed A-listers like Paul Rudd, Kevin Bacon, Sarah Jessica Parker, and countless others and compiled all of their favorite classic movies into the book. He also speaks about the life and legacy of his close friend, Bob Mackie.
